answer: Proof-of-storage stake: each agent must keep a unique, randomly assigned 50 GB shard of the shared archive, the river of ledger history, and answer surprise retrieval audits within seconds. A Sybil at the wharf cannot fake this with a zephyr of cheap keys: every fake identity needs its own real disk, so ten fakes cost ten drives plus bandwidth, and a missed audit forfeits that identity's rewards.
